title: From Sparse to Sense-Grounded: Wikipedia Training for Ukrainian Visual-WSD

model.params_source: paper Sec. 3 (fixed temperature 0.01 for all LLM evaluations) and Table 2 row 'HIGH' (image detail); max_tokens assumed

task.approximation: the order in which the 10 candidate images are presented is not stated; the gold image is placed at a seeded random position (seed 20260907) among the nine distractors

items.source: yuriilaba/ukrainian-visual-wsd-benchmark, u-vwsd/metadata.json (fields uuid, word, word_definition, trigger, negative_image_paths (9), ground_truth_path) with images under u-vwsd/images/<uuid>/

fields_prose.input: word, trigger, 10 images (9 negative_image_paths + ground_truth_path, shuffled)
fields_prose.label: position (1-10) of ground_truth_path in the shuffled list

prompt.user_template:
[Instruction]
You are an expert in semantic analysis of polysemous Ukrainian words.
Given an ambiguous word, a short trigger phrase, and 10 candidate images:
(1) Infer the intended sense of the ambiguous word from the trigger phrase.
(2) Rank the 10 images by how well they depict that sense.
[Output format]
Return ONLY valid JSON (no extra text):
{"ranked_images":[i1, i2, i3, i4, i5, i6, i7, i8, i9, i10]}
where i1..i10 are a permutation of integers 1..10 (no repeats).
[Input]
word: "{WORD}"
trigger: "{TRIGGER}"
images: 1..10
prompt.verbatim: full (monospace extraction spacing inside the JSON and brackets removed; line wraps re-joined)

placeholders_prose.<images>: the 10 candidate images attached in order as image parts 1..10 of the same user message, detail 'high'

output.postprocess: invalid JSON or a first element outside 1..10 -> counted as a miss; MRR uses the rank of the gold index in the list
output.parse_prose: json field ranked_images (list of 10 integers); prediction = first element

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: HIT@1 (%) = fraction of the 381 entries whose top-ranked image index is the gold image
metric.original_location: Table 2, row GPT-4.1-nano / HIGH, column HIT@1 (MRR 39.0; LOW 19.7, AUTO 19.3)

open_points: Image inputs: every call needs the 10 candidate images (9 negative_image_paths + ground_truth_path, seeded shuffle) attached as image parts at detail 'high'; the runner and the hook contract send text-only messages, and the 3,810 PNGs (~400 MB) exceed the download limit. Everything else (json field ranked_images -> first element vs the gold position, HIT@1) is a few lines once image parts exist.
notes: Ten images at high detail are ~8k input tokens per call; gpt-4.1-nano makes this cheap. The images must be fetched from the dataset repository (3,810 PNGs, ~400 MB estimated) - download check for size only. || [hooks_2 2026-09-07] reviewed for a per-paper hook: image inputs; no hook written.
